name: Gilded Sigil
description: An ornate amber runic ring over a subdued open-work mystic sigil.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Decorative runes carry no gameplay meaning, and cardinal letters remain runtime glyphs so they can stay upright.

orientationConventions.ring: The crowned runic index is north-up at 12 o'clock in the source texture. Apply heading only to the rose transform.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The blue spear tip points to 12 o'clock at world bearing 0. The circular boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); mount it on the rose and apply pure world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Static screen-space layer. The downward gold point is baked at 12 o'clock and marks the player's facing.
